verdict.rationale: The evidence describes LangGraph's general graph/node architecture, memory, streaming, and human-in-the-loop interrupts, but nowhere mentions guardrails, content validation, safety filtering, or blocking unsafe outputs as a first-class feature or documented pattern. While nodes are arbitrary functions (implying a developer could hand-code such logic), there is no evidence of any built-in or officially documented guardrail mechanism for input/output validation.
